notes: Attempted K8B raw I/Q capture for dab-rs OFDM sync validation (2026-05-27). After 4 capture attempts with progressively higher gain (-h 21, -h 21 + bias, manual L14/M15/V15 + bias), K-block in-band PSD remained at the noise floor with no detectable DAB OFDM structure (PSD in/out delta ~11.5 dB, zero null-symbol dips per frame, CP autocorrelation peak < 0.15). All 9 Korean K-block channels (K7A..K12C) scanned with identical max-gain settings showed the same noise-floor pattern, ruling out a per-channel issue. FM band sanity check at 89.1 MHz (KBS 2FM) with the same hardware chain succeeded (peak PSD +37.1 dB, raw |max| 1125 of 2047, normal 12-bit ADC fill), confirming that the SDR + LNA + antenna + cable chain is electrically functional. The eti-cmdline-airspy live decoder run on K8B with hardware AGC printed `There does not seem to be a DAB signal here` after 20 s of acquisition. The K-block (Band III) reception path is therefore not delivering enough signal at the current physical setup. Probable causes are physical (antenna orientation, LNA USB power not connected, room placement away from window, different antenna than the k8b_100pct success run). This capture is preserved as a noise-floor reference for the current site only.
